physicalNotes: Radius 0.24391156 Jupiter radii from Hori et al. 2024 (2024AJ....167..289H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....167..289H/abstract): 17,437.7 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. No mass is measured: Hori et al. 2024 (2024AJ....167..289H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....167..289H/abstract) gives only an upper limit of 0.06009532 Jupiter masses, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
